{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Worker where

import Data.Word (Word32, Word64)
import Data.Bits (shiftL, shiftR, (.&.), (.|.))
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BSC
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX (getPOSIXTime)
import qualified Crypto.Hash as H
import qualified Crypto.MAC.HMAC as HMAC
import qualified Data.ByteArray as BA

-- Cross-service authentication token structure
data AuthToken = AuthToken
  { tokenServiceId :: Word32
  , tokenTimestamp :: Word64
  , tokenNonce     :: Word32
  , tokenHmac      :: BS.ByteString
  } deriving (Show)

-- Job queue entry with priority and retry semantics
data JobEntry = JobEntry
  { jobId       :: Word64
  , jobPriority :: Word32
  , jobRetries  :: Word32
  , jobPayload  :: BS.ByteString
  , jobAuth     :: AuthToken
  } deriving (Show)

-- Configuration for the worker pool
data WorkerConfig = WorkerConfig
  { maxRetries      :: Word32
  , baseBackoffMs   :: Word32
  , windowSizeMs    :: Word64
  , sharedSecret    :: BS.ByteString
  , trustedServices :: [Word32]
  }

-- Compute HMAC for token verification
computeTokenHmac :: BS.ByteString -> Word32 -> Word64 -> Word32 -> BS.ByteString
computeTokenHmac secret sid ts nonce =
  let payload = BS.concat
        [ encodeWord32 sid
        , encodeWord64 ts
        , encodeWord32 nonce
        ]
      mac = HMAC.hmac secret payload :: HMAC.HMAC H.SHA256
  in BS.pack (BA.unpack (HMAC.hmacGetDigest mac))

-- Encode helpers
encodeWord32 :: Word32 -> BS.ByteString
encodeWord32 w = BS.pack
  [ fromIntegral (shiftR w 24)
  , fromIntegral (shiftR w 16)
  , fromIntegral (shiftR w 8)
  , fromIntegral w
  ]

encodeWord64 :: Word64 -> BS.ByteString
encodeWord64 w = BS.pack
  [ fromIntegral (shiftR w 56)
  , fromIntegral (shiftR w 48)
  , fromIntegral (shiftR w 40)
  , fromIntegral (shiftR w 32)
  , fromIntegral (shiftR w 24)
  , fromIntegral (shiftR w 16)
  , fromIntegral (shiftR w 8)
  , fromIntegral w
  ]

-- Verify the authentication token from a cross-service call
verifyAuth :: WorkerConfig -> AuthToken -> IO Bool
verifyAuth cfg tok = do
  now <- fmap (fromIntegral . (round :: Double -> Integer) . realToFrac) getPOSIXTime :: IO Word64
  let sid = tokenServiceId tok
      ts  = tokenTimestamp tok
      -- Calculate elapsed time safely: check ordering first
      elapsed = if now >= ts then now - ts else maxBound
      expectedHmac = computeTokenHmac (sharedSecret cfg) sid ts (tokenNonce tok)
      -- Constant-time comparison to avoid timing side channels
      hmacValid = BA.constEq expectedHmac (tokenHmac tok)
      serviceValid = sid `elem` trustedServices cfg
      -- Check if token is within acceptable time window
      windowValid = elapsed <= windowSizeMs cfg
  return (hmacValid && serviceValid && windowValid)

-- Calculate exponential backoff with retry budget
calculateBackoff :: WorkerConfig -> Word32 -> Word32
calculateBackoff cfg retryCount =
  let remaining = maxRetries cfg - retryCount
      -- Scale backoff based on retry count directly (safe: retryCount < maxRetries guaranteed)
      scaleFactor = retryCount
      backoff = baseBackoffMs cfg * (shiftL 1 (fromIntegral (scaleFactor .&. 0x1F)))
  in backoff

-- Process a single job from the queue
processJob :: WorkerConfig -> IORef [JobEntry] -> JobEntry -> IO (Either String ())
processJob cfg queueRef job = do
  authOk <- verifyAuth cfg (jobAuth job)
  if not authOk
    then return (Left "Authentication failed")
    else do
      let retries = jobRetries job
      if retries >= maxRetries cfg
        then return (Left "Max retries exceeded")
        else do
          -- Simulate job processing that might fail
          result <- executePayload (jobPayload job)
          case result of
            Right () -> return (Right ())
            Left err -> do
              let backoff = calculateBackoff cfg retries
              -- Re-enqueue with incremented retry count
              let job' = job { jobRetries = retries + 1 }
              modifyIORef queueRef (++ [job'])
              return (Left $ "Retrying after " ++ show backoff ++ "ms: " ++ err)

-- Stub for actual job execution
executePayload :: BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String ())
executePayload payload
  | BS.null payload = return (Left "Empty payload")
  | BS.head payload == 0x00 = return (Left "Simulated failure")
  | otherwise = return (Right ())

-- Main worker loop
runWorker :: WorkerConfig -> IORef [JobEntry] -> IO ()
runWorker cfg queueRef = do
  queue <- readIORef queueRef
  case queue of
    [] -> return ()
    (job:rest) -> do
      writeIORef queueRef rest
      _ <- processJob cfg queueRef job
      runWorker cfg queueRef
